provenance.note: Discovered via the EMODnet Bathymetry HR-DTM WFS (emodnet:hr_bathymetry_area). The WFS publishes a product release year and no seabed stability, so both are taken from the source programme instead: the tile is 2011 DGT/APA airborne LiDAR over rocky reef. seabed_stability drives whether depth MAE may carry the accuracy claim, so it is recorded from the survey, not guessed from the release.

layer_spec.description: Airborne bathymetric LiDAR digital terrain model of the Arrabida coast, 1/128 arc-minute (about 11 x 14 m). Depth in metres below Lowest Astronomical Tide, positive down; land and intertidal masked. Surveyed 2011, gridded by EMODnet 2020. Validated against 60 CCMAR diver quadrats: MAE 1.77 m at 60/60 coverage, versus 13.35 m at 30/60 for the 115 m EMODnet DTM. Carries an uncorrected LAT-to-water-level datum offset of about -1.3 m. Reaches about 29 m depth. Not for navigation.
